items.body: A Murder of Crows returns to New York this September for its eleventh edition, again bringing together artists from across the goth, deathrock, darkwave, and post-punk spectrum. Presented by The Red Party and The Nite Church, the 2026 festival runs from Thursday, September 3 through Sunday, September 6, with an opening party at TV Eye, two main nights at Bowery Ballroom, and a livestreamed closing party. The central attraction is a pair of Bowery Ballroom bills on September 4 and 5, led by two figures with deep ties to the music’s formative years: Anja Huwe, the former singer of German post-punk pioneers Xmal Deutschland, and Los Angeles deathrock veterans Kommunity FK. Around them, the festival has assembled a cross-generational roster of established underground bands and newer acts from the United States and Canada. Founded in 2015 after a late-night conversation among scene regulars at Leipzig’s Wave-Gotik-Treffen, A Murder of Crows began as a small Mercury Lounge gathering. It has since grown into one of New York’s most dependable annual dark-music weekends: a festival built around bands that are often overlooked by conventional promoters, plus the DJs, photographers, record collectors, and longtime friends who keep the city’s goth community connected year-round. Friday, September 4 — Bowery Ballroom Friday’s program is topped by Anja Huwe, whose work with Xmal Deutschland helped establish a sharp, severe strain of early-’80s German goth and post-punk. Her appearance gives the weekend a direct link to that era, while the rest of the night points toward the scene’s present. Dallas goth-rock outfit Rosegarden Funeral Party joins California darkwave band Creux Lies, Portland’s Nyx Division, and California’s Guilty Strangers. It is a strong first-night bill, moving from Huwe’s foundational presence through bands that have kept the genre active in clubs, independent venues, and festival rooms on both coasts. Saturday, September 5 — Bowery Ballroom Kommunity FK headlines Saturday’s lineup. Formed in Los Angeles at the dawn of the 1980s, the band remains a vital name in the West Coast deathrock and post-punk tradition, with a catalogue that has continued to find new listeners among younger goth audiences. They will be joined by New York’s Blacklist, whose dark, guitar-driven post-punk has long been part of the city’s underground fabric; Utah deathrock band Tragic Black; Georgia outfit Entertainment; and Ontario’s Modele. The second night promises the rougher, more guitar-forward side of the festival’s programming, with hometown veterans sharing the stage with bands from farther afield. Opening and Closing Parties The weekend begins Thursday, September 3 at TV Eye in Ridgewood with the official opening party. Wingtips and Grimly Fiendish will perform live, followed by A Night of a Thousand DJs, featuring Sean Templar, Dave Bats, Patrick, Hi-Fi Hillary, Scary Lady Sarah, William Faith, Mistress McCutchan, Miz Margo, Kamikaze Tomato, Detra, Matt V-Christ, and Mark Splatter. Entry to the opening party is free with a two-day festival pass. The formal in-person program closes Saturday night, but the festivities continue on Sunday, September 6 with a livestreamed closing party via twitch.tv/redpartynyc. A Murder of Crows XI takes place at Bowery Ballroom on September 4 and 5. Doors open at 7 p.m.; the events are 21+. Find tickets and complete festival information here. A Murder of Crows XI 2026 Lineup: Thursday, September 3 — TV Eye: Wingtips, Grimly Fiendish, A Night of a Thousand DJs Friday, September 4 — Bowery Ballroom: Anja Huwe, Rosegarden Funeral Party, Creux Lies, Nyx Division, Guilty Strangers Saturday, September 5 — Bowery Ballroom: Kommunity FK, Blacklist, Tragic Black, Entertainment, Modele Sunday, September 6 — Online: Livestreamed closing party via The Red Party Twitch channel Follow A Murder of Crows: Instagram The Red Party Twitch Linktree Website The post A Murder of Crows 2026 Brings Anja Huwe, Kommunity FK, Creux Lies, Nyx Division, Blacklist, and More to NYC This September appeared first on Post-Punk.com.

items.body: For an overview of the what, the why, and the where of this music, do read my review of Volume 1 of this series. Essentially, this collection is more of what made Volume 1 so infectious. Yet, what makes this music so fascinating in general, that is, beyond its unswerving ability to fill dance floors, is the fact that these two islands, part of the Paises Africanos de Lingua Oficial Portuguesa (PALOP) regions of the world, are the second smallest African country; Seychelles is smaller. There are only 12 villages on Sao Tom�, lots of rain forest and, not surprisingly, lots of rain. I mention this because one could be fooled into thinking, with music like what�s on offer here, there must have been a music scene larger than there actually was. Not that little was happening, but that less got recorded or released than it might have had there been a city such as Lagos or Nairobi with the studios, labels, and pressing plants to better document it all. The music here, like Volume 1- recorded during Africa�s so-called golden age- is known as Puxa, a complex stew of ingredients from other former African Portuguese colonies mixed with rhythms that, with the help of dancers, can summon spirits or exorcise demons. At least according to some. It�s worth knowing that a 100 years or so ago, the Portuguese banned Puxa dance; it�s also worth knowing they appear to have failed miserably at this silly endeavor. Tucked away in modern Puxa is merengue, Kompas, Soukouss, Benga, and much else. One suspects much of this is coincidental, while other grooves were definitely imported considering both Portuguese rule and the islands� location over the Atlantic from the Caribbean. But don�t be fooled into thinking these two islands don�t have their own thing, as the sounds on this collection show. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s - Pedro Lima Pedro Lima, who has featured in his own Bongo Joe collection, leads a fiery band, complete with choked guitar vamps tussling with a kit drummer as a lead guitar comments from the sidelines on �Sossegado.� Elsewhere, Sangazuza demonstrates what happens when the bass and keys drop out, leaving the drummers and guitars to ride out a groove and drive dancers mad in the process. Check �Sono s� ku� de t�ma� or �Mairo bi cedo� for their ability to place a firm finger on the pulse. Over 15 tracks, the collection shows off multiple guitars weaving and circling one another, with lead and harmony vocals constantly in response, becoming part of the songs� melodic framework. At any given moment, vocals give way as the music unspools and floats on grooves that must have gone on for hours live. Africa Negra�s �Apoi�mos a luta dos nossos irm�os� is one example. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s by Various Artists In general, what�s on offer here, like Volume 1, was recorded at Radio Sao Tom� e Principe (RSTP), often taped in the courtyard outside at night, and released on cassette or occasionally, vinyl. It captures the joy of post-1975 independence and only fizzled out as styles changed and musicians struggled to make ends meet. Yet, take a quick listen to recent RSTP programming, which features musicians such as Babilonia or Calema, and you�ll still hear Puxa rhythms, showing just how potent the music form this two-island nation is on a global level. And Bongo Joe, who have also released two volumes featuring the above mentioned Africa Negra, have given this music the treatment it deserves, with extensive notes on the country�s history, vintage photographs, and band discographies. items.label: Bongo Joe
items._genre: world music / afro-caribbean fusion / Puxa / dance groove
items._cn_summary: 这张合辑聚焦于70-80年代圣多美和普林西比的音乐场景，是一种被称为Puxa的复合节奏，融合merengue、Kompas、Soukouss、Benga等多种元素。乐评指出这些岛屿虽小，却孕育出充满律动的音乐，多把吉他相互交织，主唱与和声彼此呼应，形成旋律框架。Pedro Lima的乐队演奏激烈，吉他riff与鼓手交锋；Sangazuza则展示低频与键盘退出后鼓与吉他如何将舞者带入癫狂。Africa Negra的曲目是典型代表，节奏绵长延伸，足以让人联想到现场数小时的持续演奏。整体体现了前葡萄牙殖民地独特的跨大西洋音乐对话，介于非洲与加勒比之间，具有鲜明的地域文化色彩。

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.
Tiny Sun -
Vanishment
(Review)
Carolina Chocolate Drops -
Genuine Negro Jig
(Review)
items.label: Buda Musique
items._genre: musette / chanson / ragtime / jug band / eclectic folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由Dominique Cravic与Les Primitifs du futur合作完成，封面由地下漫画家Robert Crumb绘制。专辑汇集了27首短曲，融合法国bal-musette、拉格泰姆、 Jug band、法国香颂、skiffle等多种难以归类的风格，演奏乐器包括手风琴、萨克斯、木琴、单簧管、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他、风笛及音乐锯。Cravic以近似Maurice Chevalier的方式说唱演绎。曲目涵盖1925年老歌《Ukulele Lady》及向2020年去世的法国抵抗运动女歌手Juliette Gréco致敬的作品《N'oublie pas Gréco》。整张专辑呈现出在阁楼中翻出78转唱片并以即兴方式重塑的怀旧气质，由七旬乐手以严肃态度与热情演奏，将被遗忘的音乐风格赋予新生。

I want to personally direct you to a remarkable piece of music titled "Two Views of a Prayer," composed and written by
David Dzubinski
as part of the
Prism Quartet
's new series of collaborations called
Unlocking Your Inner Composer
. If you have listened to my radio programs, you are probably familiar with the quartet's ground-breaking, genre-blurring music. If not, there's no better introduction than this.
Performed in November of 2025 at the Free Library of Philadelphia, they invited vocalist
Ursula Rucker
, percussionist
Tyshawn Sorey
, and violinist
Carlos Santiago
to collaborate on the arrangement and performance of Dzubinski's composition. It travels from raw to lyrical and back in the course of just under 4 minutes, with both finesse and energy. - Cliff Furnald, editor

items._genre: contemporary classical / chamber music / genre-blurring / improvisation
items._cn_summary: 这是由作曲家 David Dzubinski 创作的作品「Two Views of a Prayer」，作为 Prism Quartet「Unlocking Your Inner Composer」系列合作项目的一部分，于2025年11月在费城免费图书馆演出。Prism Quartet 邀请了人声表演者 Ursula Rucker、打击乐手 Tyshawn Sorey 与小提琴家 Carlos Santiago 共同参与编排与演奏。该作品以不足四分钟的篇幅，在粗粝与抒情之间往返穿梭，展现出精致的控制力与充沛的能量。评论者强调 Prism Quartet 长期致力于打破流派边界的音乐探索，这首作品是了解其创作理念的良好切入点。整体呈现出学院派爵士与当代古典融合的特征，同时融入了即兴元素与人声表演，对偏好实验与跨界融合的听众具有一定吸引力。

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items.label: Go' Danish Folk Music
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自丹麦三人组合的处女作EP，包含五首以北欧民谣传统为主的曲目。乐队由Nordic folk圈内资深主唱Mia Guldhammer领衔，演奏者各自带入不同视角诠释传统音乐。开场曲以粗犷的奔跑节奏展示了主唱极具说服力的声线，口簧琴与风笛推动节奏。唯一原创曲目由乐队成员Morten Musicus创作。传统曲目中加入了cimbalom（扬琴）作为细腻背景，口簧琴与长笛、弦乐交织的器乐曲收尾，呈现出错位而刺激的质感。五首曲目展示了乐队早熟的成熟度，为后续全长专辑留下期待。整体定位偏向世界音乐中的北欧民谣分支，与用户主要偏好的实验、前卫、电子方向有一定距离，但传统乐器与编曲的结合仍展现出一定的跨界特质。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary / sound art
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是由录音师伊恩·布伦南在芝加哥街头录制的枪支暴力幸存者口述实录。25位年龄从17岁到67岁的参与者讲述了暴力如何影响他们的生活，录制地点位于南城区一栋94岁老人住所的前廊，背景中可听到中途机场飞机降落的声音与街头的犬吠。编辑明确指出录音中未添加任何音乐元素，仅保留环境声与受访者的声音。一位失去两个儿子的老人在讲述时情绪崩溃，反复道歉——这份真实成为整个项目最沉重的部分。项目收益将捐赠给反暴力公益组织。所有录音已在Bandcamp平台完整公开。

items._cn_summary: 这是西班牙吉他手Dani Janú的第三张专辑，融合弗拉门戈、加泰罗尼亚民谣、古典音乐、爵士及诗歌文本等多种元素。Janú毕业于巴塞罗那 Liceu 高等音乐学院，并在西班牙、德国、法国、意大利及印度等地深造古典、弗拉门戈、爵士与探戈。专辑曲目涵盖吉他与长笛的细腻对话、循环音效、人声打击乐，以及从1938年家族诗作改编的伦巴作品，以纪念他未曾谋面的祖父。另有受家乡Can Finestres启发的探戈风格器乐曲，并以巴塞罗那传奇吉他手Toti Soler创作的tanguillos收尾，乐评认为该专辑代表新一代加泰罗尼亚学院派艺术家，将弗拉门戈视为多元影响之一而非唯一根基。整体展现了跨地域、跨流派的融合思路与扎实的古典训练背景。

items.body:
How do you celebrate 50 years of music by a band that blazed trails for the charged, hypnotic pizzica sound, breaking it out of its homeland in southern Italy? How do you look afresh at a sound that�s changed and broadened its appeal without ever abandoning its roots as a new generation took over the instruments? It�s a challenge, but what Canzionere Grecanico Salentino (CGS) have done is reframe some of the pieces from those earlier decades through the lens of those playing and singing the songs now.
The brainchild of Rina and Daniele Durante, early CGS avidly proudly staked out its territory as champions of an almost forgotten culture. In the hands of their son, fiddler/frame drummer and singer Mauro Durante, the original vision has gone global (he also has a successful duo with guitarist Justin Adams) and they�ve become a major name in world music for their energy and outstanding musicality. They�ve made people in so many countries believe in the pizzica. One big milestone acceptance came with working alongside the celebrated pianist Ludovico Einaudi on his
Taranta
project in 2014, which gave them an even wider reach and boosted them even high. Very aptly, a remix and remastering of the �Taranta� track with him is included.
In a world that loves to dance, this is dance music with depth and power that explodes out of the speakers. It honors the material from the past while keeping its eyes firmly fixed on the future, clasping hands across the generations to celebrate the band and its lauded history.
Il Mito
(The Myth) pays homage without ever being slavish. There�s a real, urgent energy to the music-making here.
The title cut was written by the older Durantes, a cornerstone of CGS�s early repertoire and a reflection on life in their part of Italy. Roberto Licci comes to sing with his son Emanuele. Early vocalist Rossella Pinto reprises her role on �Lu Rusciu De Lu Mare.� Yet this isn�t all hearkening to the past. The sounds have taken on new colors and arrangements as younger fingers play them. It�s still mostly acoustic, with a few electric touches like a synth bass to round out the sound.
This is still completely Italian music, the enveloping, dry sound of pizzica, something that�s evolved over the last half-century, moving from a regional to a global stage. The band, and their compositions, deserve the party, but it begs the question:
Where will all this be in another 50 years?
items.label: Ponderosa Music
items._genre: pizzica / world music / folk / Italian traditional
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是为庆祝意大利南部撒伦蒂诺格里卡音乐合奏团成立五十周年而作，由乐队创始人之子小提琴手、手鼓与歌手毛罗·杜兰特接手后重新编排了乐队数十年来的曲目。专辑保留了皮齐卡舞曲的原始能量与意大利本土文化根基，同时在编曲中加入合成贝斯等少量电声元素，为传统声响注入新色彩。制作还邀请了早期成员回巢献唱，并与钢琴家鲁多维科·艾奥迪合作重混了2014年的塔兰塔项目曲目。整体在传统与当代之间搭建桥梁，跨代乐手交替演奏赋予老曲新生命，但手法仍以原声为主，融合程度有限。

items.body: W�R, Kongero - Songbooks Live by Nordic Notes This collaboration between the five-piece Belgian instrumental group W�r, whose members specialize in bringing the music of earlier centuries to life, and Kongero, the acclaimed Swedish female acapella folk quartet, offers an unusual chance to explore how their two cultures, ostensibly so different, can come together. It might sounds an unlikely mix, but here�s a spoiler: it turns out they�re pretty much musical best friends. The album kicks off at a cracking pace with �Var �r Du?�, a bravura performance through a twisted, tortuous piece that manages to be both elegant and surprising. However, the true astonishment arrives at the end, when the audience applauds and you suddenly realize this was recorded live (actually over two separate performances). W�R, Kongero - Songbooks Live by Nordic Notes The musicians bring material from their separate traditions, plus one original, showcasing their skills in intricate, swinging arrangements for both instruments and voices. Thanks to their skill, the varied ideas fit together seamlessly so it�s brimming with delights, like the wonderfully-titled �Drinking Like A Sweet Swede,� where the singers layers their harmonies over a jaunty backing. Everything is intricate, performed with a glowing precision that can disarm the senses with its beauty. The highlight, perhaps, is the beautiful �Klosterjungfrun.� The slow, seductive opening draws in the listener, the voices airy and light, curling around each other as the instruments wind long their path their. It�s a beautiful piece, but really, just one gem among so many here. W�R, Kongero - Songbooks Live by Nordic Notes There�s never a foot wrong, no note out of place and the performances are passionate, stellar, a true collaboration of instruments and voices. Add to that a mix that�s sharp as a razor, and Songbooks Live is a truly outstanding album, a perfect illustration that people have more in common than separates them. And it illustrates exactly what artists can achieve live. With luck, they�ll work together again. Soon, please. Find the artists online. items._cn_summary: 比利时五人器乐团体与瑞典女声四重唱合作，将文艺复兴与巴洛克时期的欧洲早期音乐与北欧传统民歌并置现场演绎。两支乐队各自贡献本文化素材，辅以一首原创作品，器乐与人声在复杂编排中交织出层次丰富的对位与和声。专辑在两场现场演出中录制，制作锐利清晰，保留了现场空间的真实感。文本中并未出现任何传统意义上的"实验"手法——没有即兴、没有声音设计、没有跨界嫁接——而是以严谨的早期音乐美学为骨架，强调技艺精度与文化对话。这种克制而精致的声音取向对热爱早期音乐、欧洲传统民谣的听众有吸引力，但与电子、即兴或当代实验等领域的契合度有限。

items.body: Echo by Emi Makabe L oss galvanizes, loss focuses, and musical artists turn loss into shared reflections. Emi Makabe has focused the passing of her father into a generous meditation on resilience and legacy with her second recording on Sunnyside Records, Echo . The title reminds us of the connections between generations. Here are ten musical memories that span time and culture, blending a modern jazz sensibility with a traditional Japanese soul. Born in Japan, where she studied Japanese traditional music, Emi Makabe moved to New York in 2008. She is an educator and contributor to the jazz scene, composing and performing her own music. Her previous recordings, an EP on the Japanese Jazz label D-Musica Out of Time (2016) and Anniversary (2020), laid the foundation of her sound: soaring, sweet singing in Japanese, English and wordless vocalizing, accompanied by her flute and shamisen on top of jazz-inspired piano, drums, and double bass. Using these materials, Makabe celebrates the legacy of her father, supported by Thomas Morgan (double bass, backing vocals) and Vitor Gon�alves (piano, accordion, Wurlitzer electric piano), both of whom return from her previous records, as well as Kenny Wollesen (drums, percussion, vibraphone, electronics). Also appearing as guests are Meshell Ndegeocello (spoken word), Jason Moran (piano), and Bill Frisell (acoustic guitar) on the opening track. Echo by Emi Makabe Opening with Frisell�s acoustic guitar and confidently sentimental, �Birthday Song� comes to grips with loss, featuring a touching spoken meditation and a haunting Frisell solo. It ends with the hope, �I wanna remember the warmth of being in your arms.� The record closes with �Overture,� anchored by Gon�alves� dripping Wurlitzer supporting Makabe�s Japanese exhortation, �Let's talk again, countless times/Let's talk, if we meet again.� Echo by Emi Makabe Besides the refreshingly unselfconscious sentimentality, Makabe strides confidently between the traditional Japanese melodies, instruments, and the language of her upbringing in her father�s world and the contemporary jazz of New York clubs. �Snow� begins with Makabe�s shamisen playing a pentatonic tune, while �Text� swings in a fast bebop, with Makabe�s flute and harmonized Japanese scat singing. Echo by Emi Makabe �Morisan� hurries between worlds led by bouncy accordion, rolling jazz traps, and a stylish piano solo by Jason Moran. Moran also shares production credits with Thomas Morgan and Makabe herself. Utterly unique in approach, and equipped with a lovely vocal instrument, and with a skilled and single-minded ensemble, Emi Makabe has created a passionate, introspective, and honest fusion of tradition and modernity to celebrate the passing of the generations. Find the artist online. Further listening: Carmen Souza - The Silver Messengers: A Tribute to Horace Silver Mamak Khadem - Rembrance Yussef Dayes - Black Classical Music

items._cn_summary: 一支音乐人团队远赴纽芬兰最偏远的地区，录制当地教堂中古老管风琴的声响。这张专辑聚焦于濒临消失的乐器遗产，通过实地录音捕捉教堂声学空间与管风琴音色的独特共鸣。纽芬兰作为加拿大东海岸的边缘地带，其宗教音乐传统融合了英国、爱尔兰移民文化与本地环境特征，具有鲜明的地域文化视角。录音呈现了这些因年久失修而鲜少被演奏的乐器，在修缮后重新发声的过程，展现了田野录音与民族音乐学相结合的艺术价值。对于关注世界音乐、声音艺术和田野录音的听众而言，这一项目在保存声音遗产方面具有独特意义。

items.body: Review by toroddreincarnated — Beware, this is probably my one and only review here as I run my own blog. This box deserves moreattention than my review blog can give it. Hence this review...The 8 studio albums plus 1 live album plus a couple of leftover songs from this band.All the albums were released as CD-R in 100 copies each. They were also released locally in the Bodoarea (where they were based) and are almost impossible to find. Hence this box. Hence this review.The man behind the band was Odd Fredrik Fezza Ellingsen, ex Host, Akasha and St. Helena. He was themain force on one of Scandinavia's early masterpieces of progressive rock; Host's Hardt Mot Hardtalbum (1976).In my reviews of Lovetann's eight albums for my own blog, I have compared them to Thule's Natt opus.I have also, tongue in cheek, labelled Lovetann and Thule as Arctic Prog bands. There is some truthin this label, but this suggestion is only half-serious.Lovetann's music is a unique blend of folk-rock and art-rock. The vocals are baryton operaticvocals. This band was one of the truly originals in the progressive rock scene. Their location wellbeyond the Arctic Circle and 1000 miles/1500 km from the nearest progressive rock scene (Trondheim/Oslo) also gave the band its own sound and style.I have below copied over extracts of the reviews of the eight albums previously reviewed & publishedin my own blog The Sound Of Fighting Cats. This is the only way to review this box in the fairestway.I Lovens Hule 1999The debut album. The music is a blend of prog folk and heavy prog. Both Thule and Host are good references. There arealso some Jethro Tull references here. I am tempted to label the music here and indeed Thule's music as Arctic Prog. The music and soundare pretty unique. That's not least because of the pretty operatic male vocals. The music is alsobombastic and slightly symphonic. The songs are pretty long with a lot of progressions throughout the songs. The vocals are good, butthe star here is the very good guitar solos and riffs.That makes this a good album indeed and one to check out. This album is indeed a hidden gem and oneto check out.En Dag Som Love 1999 The music is a blend of dark art-rock and dark symphonic prog. Both Thule and Host are goodreferences.As I did in the review of their debut album, I am tempted to label their music as Arctic Prog. Thisas they have the same depressive, dark sound and take on progressive rock and art-rock as theirbrethren 1000 km further north, Thule. Both Lovetann and Thule released their music well north ofthe Arctic Circle.The music is made even darker by some dark operatic male vocals, darkened guitar harmonies andguitar solos. The bass is also brooding.The four songs are all good and this is another good album from this band. This is an album fans of Thule and dark prog should check out.Ansikt Til Ansikt 2000 The music is again pretty special. The music is a blend of dark art-rock and dark symphonic prog.Thule is again a good reference. There are some more dark psych rock this time around. Arctic Prog is what I would label their and Thule music as I did in my reviews of their first twoalbums. That does not really give any meaning.. The vocals are again dark operatic male vocals.This album is not as good as their first two albums. This is still a pretty good album.. but still abit of a disappointment. Sfinks 2000The music is again what I would define as arctic prog. The band is from beyond the Arctic Circlewith total darkness for 5 months of the year. The same goes for Thule, another band in this region,although 1000 km further north. That means a blend of dark folk rock and art-rock. There are also some hints of symphonic prog here.The music is depressive with some guitar solos and operatic baritone Norwegian vocals on top of thesound.The music is muscular but not particularly heavy. There are some good Jethro Tull influencesthroughout this album. This is not their finest album. The quality is pretty good though. Fans of Scandinavian prog rockshould check out this album.Oye For Oye 2001 The music is again a blend of dark folk rock and art-rock. There are also some hints of symphonicprog here. The music is mid-tempo and dark. The guitars from Odd Fezza Ellingsen (Host etc etc) are the dominant instrument here. The dark operatic male vocals also give this album a lot of character. The sound is good and there is a lot of Arctic ambience here. Those who love Thule will also findthis album enjoyable and interesting.The quality here is pretty good. I am not won over by this album. It is still an interesting albumand an original take on progressive rock, art-rock and folk rock.Lovehjerte 2001 The music is an eclectic blend of folk rock, art-rock and early symphonic prog. Both Host and Thule are good references here. The music is a bit vaudeville and operatic at times. That is not at least because of the vocals. Themain vocals are operatic male vocals. The lyrics are a mix of Norwegian and English. The band has moved in a more vaudeville art-rock direction on the last couple of albums. This albumis very much in that direction. The sound is good. The music also sounds like it is influenced by the dark nights beyond the Arctic Circle where thisband comes from. The quality of the music is pretty good and this makes it an interesting album. It is an album forthose who are looking for something original and special. Something unique and exotic.Fugl Foniks 2003 The music is a blend of folk rock, art-rock and heavy prog. There are also some symphonic proginfluences here.This type of prog, both this band and Thule 1000 km further north in Norway were doing, deserves itsown label... Arctic Prog. The reason is that the music is pretty unique and very much rooted in thelife and landscape beyond the Arctic Circle.The lyrics are now entirely in English this time around and a departure from the Norwegian lyrics ontheir first albums. The music is pretty hard with some raw guitars. The vocals are both operatic and good. The music is pretty good. This is not one of their best albums. Nevertheless, this is an album wellworth checking out.The Times 2013The music is again a blend of folk-rock and art-rock. There are also a lot of eclectic prog here.Their albums have become more and more eclectic on each album. This album is pretty close to beingan eclectic prog album. I would still label their music as Arctic Prog.There are some very good guitars here. Mostly guitar solos and harmonies. The operatic vocals are also very good here. These vocals is giving Lovetann's music it's ownidentity.The vocals are entirely in English and this makes this album more accessible for the Englishspeaking prog rock fans.The quality is good throughout and this album offers some good value for money. This is perhapstheir best album ever.That is these 8 albums. There is also a good live album in the box too.This box has been released in a limited number. This box is something unique in the progressive rockscene and can only be purchased from Norske Albumklassikere directly. Collectors of Scandinavian progressive rock, rare progressive rock and other collectors shouldpurchase this box. For these reasons, all three of them, that is I purchased this box. I was notdisappointed with it as the music and the packaging are great.The album can be purchased directly from Norske Albumklassikere at their webshop

items._cn_summary: LøVETANN 是来自挪威北博德地区、位于北极圈以北的独立乐队，核心人物 Odd Fredrik Fezza Ellingsen 曾是 1976 年前卫摇滚经典专辑的主创者。这套 Opus Magnum 1999-2024 盒子套装收录了乐队全部八张录音室专辑、一张现场专辑以及若干散落曲目，由于原始版本仅以限量 CD-R 和本地方式发行，外界几乎无法获得，此套装将这些珍稀录音集中再版。乐评将乐队的音乐风格定位为民谣摇滚与艺术摇滚的独特融合，特点是男中音歌剧式演唱、阴沉的和声与吉他独奏、阴郁的低音线以及交响化的编曲。歌曲篇幅较长，发展层次丰富，兼有 Jethro Tull 民谣元素与挪威前卫先驱 Thule 的阴暗气质，乐评因此创造了"北极前卫"这一概念来概括其因地理隔绝而形成的独特声音。从分类看属于跨界前卫摇滚，与听众偏好的实验前卫、电子、暗潮等方向有一定距离，但艺术摇滚的暗黑质感和独特的北欧地域视角仍具一定参考价值。

items.body: Review by Aussie-Byrd-Brother — Young modern Italian band Cellar Noise delivered an appealing debut `Alight' back in 2017, a charming first effort grounded firmly in the tradition of vintage RPI works. Their follow-up, `Nautilus', only two years later saw a complete abrupt turn, the group embracing instead a modern approach and ditching the majority of retro flavours (similar to fellow young Italian group Ingranaggi Della Valle who moved on quickly from their retro roots). Their latest, 2026's `Panic Loves Telling Lies' sees the five-piece combining both of those approaches, fusing a contemporary heaviness with extravagant classical fancy, then grafting them to sophisticated song-writing, and it results in their strongest and most polished effort yet, with a range of international influences revealing themselves throughout.The band describe their third album as being "centred around the experience of being trapped within one's own mind, held captive by rigid mental constructs shaped by fear and self-deception. Defence mechanisms created as safety nets and survival tools, both reassuring and deceptive at the same time. However, as balance slowly deteriorates and panic intensifies, a subtle possibility of freedom emerges beneath the surface: breaking free from the cage and reclaiming one's true self, allowing a moment's respite for an exhausted and overwhelmed mind." That sense of melancholy and holding back, only to be confronted with traces of hope and light emerges constantly throughout the disc.It's instantly noticeable on opener `Wasted Potential' that vocalist Francesco Lovari, singing in charmingly accented English, is sounding more confident and natural than ever, with his weary vocal drolly delivering an introspective and dour lyric ("Every success brings less conviction" sure ain't smiles and sunshine!) over a maddening electronic loop, punchy riffing and wall-to-wall icy Mellotron, a cowering prettiness trying to break through the unhappiness.There's a gutsy crunch to `Please Be Gentle', with snarling and twitchy staccato riffing around gently pleading words, and it wouldn't have sounded out of place on a Haken album.The dramatic and atmospheric twelve-minute album standout `The Case of the Silent Queen' might be one of the strongest and most lavish pieces the band has ever delivered, with ravishing instrumentation and a purposeful sense of build, with gorgeous piano and keyboards that take on an elegant orchestration-like grandness. The group here reminds of everything from early Genesis, Steven Wilson and fellow young Italian (and now sadly seemingly defunct) band Unreal City, even calling to mind `Pure/Passion'-era Pendragon with their cross of heavier guitars while still retaining the more retro-flavoured `romantic' flavours, and the brooding second half creeps with a Goblin-like erupting menace (and there's a lovely call-back to a grand theme from their debut buried in there as well as a gift to long-time fans and close listeners!).One of the loveliest pieces on the disc, `We Need to Talk' is a soft acoustic indie pop/rocker with introspective words that recalls the indie/alt pop moments of Porcupine Tree's `Stupid Dream/Lightbulb Sun' era, and restrained cello strains brings a touch of Anekdoten's soul-searching. Framed around darkly sexy grooving riffing ala tracks like Porcupine Tree's `Strip the Soul', the Riverside-esque `Caged' holds one of the biggest choruses of the disc, a richly layered vocal with a vulnerable lyric and exquisitely arranged harmonies.Like a cross between Zombi and Lunatic Soul, slinking electronics, shimmering electric piano, murmuring bass and pulsing programmed beats slink through `The Day We Never Met', ghostly Mellotron rising like a gothic choir, and the self-titled closer `Panic Loves Telling Lies' is a pensive indie rocker that embraces the heart of some of the later Anathema works, making for a humble and subdued way to finish.Perhaps many of the tracks fall back on a similar pattern - bring the heavy guitars, launch the Mellotron! - and the band wears their current influences on their sleeves, but `Panic Loves Telling Lies' still showcases Cellar Noise's strong song-writing arrangements and vibrant instrumentation, and is more naturally melodic with richer and more expansive harmonies. It's another fine effort from the talented young quintet, and the group should be very proud of their efforts here.Three and a half stars, rounded up to four for the Archives.
items._cn_summary: 意大利五人乐队Cellar Noise的第三张专辑在复古与当代之间寻求平衡，将电子loop、冰冷Mellotron与古典化的键盘编排嫁接到现代重型吉他节奏之上。主唱以带口音的英语演唱，歌词围绕困于自身心智、被恐惧与自我欺骗所困的主题展开，忧郁与希望的光影交替贯穿全碟。十二分钟长曲《The Case of the Silent Queen》展现乐队最华丽的器乐编织，从早期Genesis的优雅到Pendragon式的浪漫重音层层递进。整体制作精致但仍属传统流派框架内的稳健之作，未跳出交响前卫摇滚的既定语法。

items.body: Review by greenpete — This is an essential album for Ayers fans as it collects choice singles, B-sides, outtakes together in one package. Ayers' best solo work covered the Joy of a Toy through Bananamour years, so it's no surprise the best songs here are his earliest. Of particular note is the gorgeous "Gemini Child" and French-sung "Jolie Madame." Also of note are "Singing a Song in the Morning" (Syd Barrett was on guitar on a different version), "Soon, Soon, Soon," "Stars," and "Puis Je?" (a French-language "May I"). The remainder will be familiar to those who have Ayers' albums, or are the bon vivant Caribbean, uh, "ditties" that he had such an affinity for.If you're unfamiliar with Kevin Ayers, I recommend either of his albums Joy of a Toy or Whatevershebringswesing. Or the compilation released by See For Miles. Then, if you're like me, you'll be so smitten with this one-of-a-kind Canterbury Scene psych-prog tunesmith, you'll be gathering every Ayers product you can lay your hands on. I envy you your journey!
items._cn_summary: 这张合辑收录了Kevin Ayers散落于各处的单曲、B面曲及遗珠作品，时间跨度覆盖其最活跃的创作阶段。评论特别推崇早期法语演唱作品及与Syd Barrett有过合作关联的曲目，指出这些歌曲集中体现了Ayers作为词曲作者的独特气质。专辑后半部分收录的是他擅长的加勒比海风格轻松小品，与前半部分的迷幻民谣形成对比。乐评整体属于资深乐迷的推荐式评论，作者建议新听众从其早期专辑入手，再逐步深入挖掘这张选辑的价值。作为Canterbury场景的核心人物之一，Ayers的作品融合了英式民谣的温柔与迷幻摇滚的怪趣，介于主流摇滚与前卫实验之间的位置。

items.body:
After the dark introspection of previous album The Crying Light, Antony Hegarty returns with a tentatively optimistic new collection of songs for the fourth Antony & The Johnsons full-length, Swanlights.

It's another achingly beautiful piece of work, and one that announces itself with the resoundingly positive 'Everything Is New' - a song that hovers in a minor key populated by harps and desolate pianos, yet still seems curiously upbeat in the wider context of Antony's discography. Recent single, 'Thank You For Your Love' further emphasises the clarity of the album's delivery, getting right to the heart of the matter with direct, largely unambiguous lyrics and a jubilant horn section. In between such moments you'll find a swelling complexity creeping into the mesmerising orchestral arrangements of 'Ghost' while darker shades begin to creep into 'The Spirit Was Gone', whose minimal, monotone refrain gives Hegarty plenty of scope for a finely dramatised vocal performance that packs a considerable emotional heft. In a more experimental mode, 'Swanlights' has the feel of something from David Sylvian's Blemish LP, swaddled in a pulsing tremolo guitar drone and closely mic-ed vocals, unencumbered by a backbeat. The album's final three entries prove especially powerful: 'Fletta' is a wonderful duet with Bjork, who returns the favour of Antony's appearance on her Volta track 'The Dull Flame Of Desire' with a showstopping turn alongside Hegarty's ostinato keywork. Both 'Salt Silver Oxygen' and 'Christina's Farm' put orchestral instrumentation to brilliant use, bringing the very best out of Antony's writing with vast, almost operatic arrangements that seem to perfectly frame her singular, tremulous vocal - a commanding and magisterial presence throughout Swanlights.

items._cn_summary: 这是Antony Hegarty的第四张全长专辑，延续前作内省气质的同时转向更为审慎的乐观。开篇曲'Everything Is New'以小调竖琴与冷寂钢琴营造忧郁氛围，却传递出积极信号。专辑贯穿丰富的管弦乐编排——'Ghost'中弦乐层层堆叠趋于繁复，'The Spirit Was Gone'以极简单调的副歌为Hegarty的戏剧化演唱留出空间。标题曲'Swanlights'引入颤音吉他持续音和近距离拾音人声，带有实验色彩。Björk客串的'Fletta'以固定低音键盘铺底，尾声三首作品将管弦乐编制推至近乎歌剧般的宏大格局，框住Hegarty独特的颤抖嗓音——整张专辑贯穿其中，成为权威而庄严的存在。

items.body: . 'Another World' resumes form, marking a return to the kind of intimate balladry he was channelling when last we heard from him, although there's some welcome dissonance soaring in the background, destabilising the sheer elegance and tranquillity of it all. 'Shake That Devil' comes as something of a surprise, featuring Antony's voice accompanied by an abrasive drone until around halfway through a drumbeat of almost industrial intensity fires up with a few loose saxophone squawks filling the gaps. It's actually a very effective, if slightly unsettling piece, necessarily providing respite between all the more obviously beautiful piano-driven material. The EP is brilliantly balanced and - as these things should - it leaves you wanting for more despite the fact that Antony's voice seems to have been ubiquitous over recent years A most satisfactory return.

items._cn_summary: 这张EP延续了Antony标志性的私密抒情路线，以钢琴驱动的优雅与宁静为主轴，同时在背景中引入不协和的嗡鸣与张力来打破表面的平静。《Shake That Devil》是全作最出人意料的一首，人声与粗糙的持续低音并置，中段突然爆发出接近工业强度的鼓击和松散刺耳的萨克斯尖啸，在甜美段落之间制造了有效的、略带不安的间奏。整张作品在安静与侵扰之间保持精妙平衡，Antony低沉而富有质感的人声依然是核心表达工具，虽未在风格上大幅突破，却以克制的手法提供了值得反复回味的聆听体验。

items.body:
Formally known as Rabbitfoot, 1000 Rabbits survey their first months and years of activity on this brittle six-track EP.

Since they first assembled in Aldeburgh two years back, 1000 Rabbits have tracked from living room to rehearsal space to stage, working through ideas and concepts to come up with a tight selection of experimentally-minded art pop that should appeal to fans of Wet Leg and Black Country New Road. If you've come across the band before, you've probably run into 'Virgin Soil' a featherlight fusion of staccato string plucks, time signature switches and orchestral swells that sits at odds with vocalist River's nonchalant recollections. 'Rubiks Cube' expands the concept a little more, adding a proggy synth low-end and more elaborate drumming, but it's the non singles that convince us that 1000 Rabbits are more than a novelty name. Peep the gossamer 'Bear Hunt', that sounds as if it coulda come from Clarissa Connelly's 'World of Work', or the lengthy, folk-flecked finale 'Spring Cleaning'.
items._genre: art pop / experimental pop / chamber pop
items._cn_summary: 1000 Rabbits（曾用名 Rabbitfoot）在此EP中回顾了成团初期数月的创作积累，推出六首紧凑曲目。这支来自英国奥尔德堡的乐队从起居空间逐步走向排练室与舞台，在实验中逐步收敛为成熟的艺术流行乐形态。乐评特别提及主打单曲之外的曲目更具说服力：弦乐拨奏、拍号切换与管弦乐涌浪与非主流动机的人声形成张力对比；某些作品带有轻盈透明的质感，可与Clarissa Connelly的创作相提并论；终曲则是一首绵长的民谣色调作品。整体呈现出从想法雏形到概念落地的成长轨迹，在流行结构中嵌入实验性编排元素。

items.body:
Back on Lolina's Relaxin label, great area turns in three tracks of plugged-in (but endearingly casual) DIY pop that's sure to speak to fans of Smerz, Astrid Sonne and Tirzah.

Like last year's impressive 'Good Coding' album, 'Love' infuses modern home-made pop with tongue-in-cheek humor and impressively deadpan lyrics. "There's doom in the data," she coos listlessly over canned violins and bone dry beats on 'Audiences change but you stay the same". It's a love song that sounds as if it's been copy pasted from a sequence of offhand texts and diary entries and the accompaniment is a canny update of the twee pop formula, replacing a full band with DAW instrumentation and Factory-style basslines. 

'Noises in a row' is another surprising earworm, extended with its trance-y keys and psych-style organ vamps, but it's all about the closing title track, a brittle electro-tinged schoolyard rhyme that's part HTRK, part Heavenly.
items._cn_summary: great area 在 Lolina 的 Relaxin 厂牌发行新专辑《Love》，收录三首 DIY 流行作品。整体以 DAW 软件制作取代传统乐队编制，罐装小提琴与干瘪节拍构成松弛却别致的编曲骨架。歌词以冷淡语调呈现，戏谑中带有冷面幽默感，将日记碎片与短信拼贴成情歌文本。配器层面在甜美流行公式中注入合成器贝斯线与迷幻键盘和声，曲目《Noises in a row》以恍惚感的键盘铺陈制造意外上口效果。标题曲《Love》则以清冷电子质感与校园童谣韵律收尾，呈现出脆弱易碎的声音质地。整体定位介于低保真流行与实验电子之间，风格偏向轻松随性的客厅制作美学。

items.body:
One of the year's standout releases - and winner of the 2005 Mercury Music Prize.

'I Am A Bird Now', the second full-length from this extraordinary New York artist and her cohorts, features contributions from both peers (Rufus Wainwright, Devendra Banhardt) and heroes (Lou Reed, Boy George). Their involvement reflects both their admiration for Hegarty, and her unique place in the contemporary arts community. "Everyone's presence on the record shows them at their most unique, making a special contribution that is specific to them," says Hegarty.
items._genre: art pop / chamber pop / experimental vocal / avant-folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是纽约艺术家的第二张全长作品，邀请了多位风格各异的客座嘉宾参与录音，包括Rufus Wainwright、Devendra Banhart、Lou Reed和Boy George等。专辑以人声为核心载体，艺术家独特的嗓音和情感表达方式构成了作品的中心轴线。嘉宾的参与并非简单助阵，而是各自贡献出最具个人特色的表现，使得专辑呈现出多元而统一的艺术气质。整张作品在主流与实验之间游走，既有旋律化的可听性，又保持了一定程度的艺术独特性，2005年曾获得英国水星音乐奖。这张专辑偏向艺术流行与室内流行的范畴，与纯粹的前卫实验或电子声响美学有一定距离，但在人声表现力和情感深度上具有独到之处。

items.body:
Antony & the Johnsons: 'Cut the World' is a collection of live symphonic performances of songs from the band's 4 full length albums.

Hegarty kicks things off with the album’s only exclusive composition, the title track ‘Cut Hands’, and sets the pace with this richly orchestrated epic. The whole album was recorded with the Danish National Chamber Orchestra, so hearing fleshed out versions of some of the standout gems of her career sounds like Hegarty is rewarding us just for being fans. These versions are so different from the originals that they almost stand up as new works, and the care and attention put into ‘Cut World’ makes it worth the asking price alone. Recommended.
items._genre: contemporary classical / orchestral pop / art song
items._cn_summary: 《Cut The World》是Antony and the Johnsons四张录音室专辑作品的现场交响乐改编版本，由丹麦国家室内乐团演奏。专辑以唯一原创曲目《Cut Hands》开场，弦乐编制宏大而层次丰富，为Hegarty原本以钢琴与人声为核心的创作注入了古典交响的厚重感。评论指出，这些改编版与原版差异极大，几乎可被视为全新作品，体现了创作者对自身作品的深度重塑与再诠释。该专辑更适合喜爱艺术流行与声乐表现的听众，与纯实验或电子语境相距较远，但其在当代古典与另类声乐交叉领域的探索仍具一定艺术价值。

items.body:
Death Is Not The End return to the soul-stir sound of deep south Sacred Harp Singers in 1993 - although it could feasibly be any time since the advent of portable tape recording - in the blessed company of the Union Grove Baptist Church, Ozark, Alabama. Feels just right in this humidity…

The Wiregrass Singers' Dewey Williams began learning the shape-note tradition in his childhood. He studied under Judge Jackson, who authored the landmark 1934 hymnbook The Colored Sacred Harp. In 1971, Williams formally organized The Wiregrass Sacred Harp Singers to preserve the music full-time. This unified troupe began touring nationally and leading workshops, which ultimately launched them onto stages at the Smithsonian and Newport folk festivals up until Williams' passing in 1995 when the group disbanded. The African-American Sacred Harp tradition in the Wiregrass region has steeply declined since the start of the 21st century, due to an aging generation of singers, and today it is largely sustained through archival preservation and occasional multi-book singing meetups.

This raw recording, made at the Union Grove Baptist Church, Ozark in mid-April 1993 finds the group singing from B. F. White’s The Sacred Harp (1844), which together with his brother-in-law William Walker’s Southern Harmony (1835) formed the musical backbone of generations of Southern music and Southern musical styles.
items._genre: sacred harp / shape-note singing / folk / americana
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑记录了1993年阿拉巴马州奥扎克联合格罗夫浸信会教堂的现场演唱，由Wiregrass Sacred Harp Singers演绎B.F. White 1844年《The Sacred Harp》中的曲调。乐评追溯了美国非裔传统圣咏的历史脉络，包括Dewey Williams在Judge Jackson指导下的学习经历，以及他1971年正式组建合唱团后在全国巡演、登上史密森尼和纽波特民谣节舞台的经历。录音呈现原始粗糙的质感，保留了南方教会音乐的纯真氛围。乐评特别指出，21世纪以来Wiregrass地区非裔圣咏传统因歌手老龄化而急剧衰退，目前主要依靠档案保护和偶尔的跨版本歌唱聚会维系。Death Is Not The End厂牌的发行让这段濒临消失的传统重新被听见，具有重要的文化抢救意义。

items.body:
Recombinant raver Low End Activist properly came into his own on this ’21 slice of inch-tight jungle saluting legendary inspirations from 4Hero to Photek, Source Direct, Digital and On Remand - and now newly pressed up to vinyl.

After minting the project in 2017 and cultivating grime mutations ft. Trim and Flowdan, Berlin’s Low End Activist more fully indulged passions for formative jungle touchstones on ‘Engineers Origin’ - the 1st plate under his eponymous label, part of a family with his prolific Sneaker Social Club. 

Entering a field of lockdown-spurred jungle emulators, LAE brought a real finesse to his sharply stylized mid ‘90s homages that elevates his work above the crowd. On the title tune he summons proper darkside spectres with poised balance of sci-fi atmosfear and technicality certain to keep toes off the ground, before ‘Look Up’ snaps into the tightest steppers motion with flinty drums and exquisite use of a screeching string sample from On Remand, and ‘Probability 1’ seals the deal with a sonorous subbass pressure cadged from Dead Prez, alloyed to depth-charged breaks.

Cold and deadly!
items._genre: jungle / drum and bass / dark electronic
items._cn_summary: Low End Activist 的这张专辑是对九十年代中期 jungle 经典场景的致敬之作，向 4Hero、Photek、Source Direct 等传奇人物致意。制作上展现了扎实的复古功力：在标题曲中以冷峻的氛围和精确的技术平衡重现了 darkside 能量，后续曲目则通过 flinty 鼓击、采样片段和深沉 subbass 构建出紧致的律动结构。整体风格偏向暗黑系电子舞池美学，低频厚重，节奏锋利。虽然在 jungle 这一相对窄众的领域内完成度不错，但对于偏好实验前卫、即兴爵士或当代古典的听众来说，类型本身的吸引力有限。这是一张专注于类型语言内部的精细化作品，融合度与实验性都维持在传统范畴之内。

items.body:
Ostgut Ton’s freshest recruits trade in effortlessly rolling bleep techno and moodier meat motors primed to be played in the big house.

Along with the likes of Quelza and Inox Traxx, Berlin-based Justine Perry & Paula Kossi lend an injection of new blood to Berghain’s label revival. Their ‘Paired Works’ oscillate energies between Perry’s effervescent levity and Koski’s rolling momentum, with the latter at best on the stealth build of ‘Beyond the Line’ and finely poised, teasing pressure of ‘Opaline’, while Kossi best impresses with the concentrated, urgent canter of ‘Maeve’, with its plucky bassline, plus the dub chord-riding ‘Adnexa’, and Fadi Mohem-esque elegance of ‘Held in Place’.
items._cn_summary: 这张合辑由两位柏林新晋制作人联手呈现，收录于传奇俱乐部Berghain旗下厂牌。整体在techno的框架内游走：一侧偏向轻盈流畅的bleep techno线条，合成器音色清澈、节奏行进明快；另一侧则更具暗沉重量感，dub和弦层叠铺陈，低频推进沉稳有力。制作上注重段落铺陈与能量递进，部分曲目带有近似minimal techno的精密构建感与悬挂式张力。双人合作方式形成互补式的对比美学，一张专辑内同时呈现两种不同的俱乐部舞池取向。对于熟悉柏林电子场景的听众而言，这是一张工整且具备一定完成度的厂牌新作，但整体仍处于techno的常规范畴之内，实验性边界有限。

items.body:
Josh da Costa makes his solo debut with New Wave Graveyard, an album which pays tribute to a spectrum of underground music and carves out a new niche.

"New Wave Graveyard might draw on the ‘70s and ‘80s genre that gives the album its name, but new wave is one of many of Josh da Costa’s musical inspirations – the album is a beautiful soup of styles and ideas, from glam to shoegaze, all informed by Josh’s eclectic taste. With witty lyrics and an abundance of catchy songs, New Wave Graveyard is a thrilling statement from an exciting new artist."

items._cn_summary: Josh Da Costa首张个人专辑将多种地下音乐风格融为一炉，以七十年代末至八十年代初的新浪潮为名义基底，实则跨越华丽摇滚、自赏派与新浪潮等多个领域。乐评指出这是一锅"风格与想法的美丽浓汤"，歌词机智诙谐，歌曲旋律抓耳。专辑作为这位新艺术家的首张个人宣言，被认为展现了令人兴奋的创作姿态。其音乐视野的杂食性是最大亮点，融合手法兼顾复古根基与个人趣味，但整体仍偏向吉他摇滚框架内的风格拼贴，距离更极端的实验性或电子化方向有一定距离。

items.body: Review by Heart of the Matter — This fantastic concert, advertised as the "solo albums tour" in order to capitalize the expectatives originated in their 1975 sabatical, dedicated by each band member to their own project, remained until its 50th anniversary as a legendary, sought-after bootleg. Now officially released, it presents us with a Yes formation, including Patrick Moraz on keyboards (Wakeman's replacement), shining in the full splendour of their mid-seventies. Bold, exploratory and going full throttle from the start, the band is up to the energy level displayed in their previous studio release, the album Relayer. This is well represented here, of course, by Sound Chaser and the side-long epic The Gates of Delirium. Also, the same virtuosism and powerful sonic brilliance are put into the staple versions, such as Siberian Kathru and I've Seen All Good People, and an extraordinary rendition of Ritual, sending sparks from the bottom of those Topographic Oceans.The songs coming from the solo albums, in the form of excerpts taken from Jon Anderson's Olias Of Sunhillow and Moraz' Story Of I, offer a welcome relaxing moment, including also a newly fashioned, acoustic rendition of Long Distance Runaround, so brief as full of charm.What else? Oh, yeah, all this comes from the hearts and hands of musicians listening to each other tight, instead of to a metronome. Better to seize than to miss, don't you think?
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / live recording
items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了1976年Yes乐队在新泽西罗斯福体育场的演出，由键盘手帕特里克·莫拉兹顶替韦克曼，乐队正处于七十年代中期的巅峰状态。演出涵盖了前一张录音室专辑《Relayer》中的《Sound Chaser》和长达一整面的《The Gates of Delirium》，同时呈现了经典曲目《Siberian Khatru》《I've Seen All Good People》的现场版本，以及《Ritual》的一次出色演绎。来自个人项目的选段——安德森的《Olias of Sunhillow》和莫拉兹的《Story of I》——提供了节奏上的缓和，其中还包含一段简短而精致的原声版《Long Distance Runaround》。乐评强调乐队成员之间的紧密互动而非机械式的节拍器配合，整体呈现出探索性、大胆而充满活力的现场质感。

items.body: Review by BrufordFreak — A second studio album put together in 1971 in London under the supervision of producer Tony Visconti (and also receiving the artistic talents of Roger Dean for the album art).1. "Beautiful Seven" (6:45) some soulful High Life music that has the advantage of Western rock production values to bring about better definition to and performances from each of the individual instruments. (Tony is figuring out how to mic and engineer this band!) The melodies, engineering, and mixes here are so much more superior to anything on the band's previous album (which was released within the same calendar year). The SANTANA-like jam that emerges in the final minute is what I've been looking more for. Still, the overall quality of the sound and performances is so much better than Osibisa. (13.75/15)2. "Y Sharp" (6:21) Memphis Blues-Rock sounding like it's coming straight out of the Stax recording studios--as if Isaac Hayes and David Porter were composing their music! Very enjoyable, nicely-polished mostly-instrumental music of a generic type that the musicians are embellishing with satisfactory spirit and inspiration. (9.125/10) 3. "Spirits Up Above" (7:18) a song that opens up sounding like PROCOL HARUM or THE SPENCER DAVIS GROUP setting up a ballad. But then the unusual tandem of trumpet and flute present the dirge-like melody lines over wah-wah-ed electric guitar and baritone sax. Wow! This is then trumped by the entrance and vocal presence of a church-like "Baptist" choir singing what could be a eulogy for a minute or so. Then the band suddenly kicks into Blues-Rock third gear with a two-chord vamp over which Robert Bailey's electric piano solos over Roy Bedeau and Sol Amarfino's excellent bass and drumming, respectively. Wendel Richardson's guitar solo is next and it's really cool with chord sliding and multi-note picking, all the while the horn section is supporting with its smooth long notes--until the seventh minute when the individual horns start to meander off onto their paths. What an awesome jam! This is by far the best thing I've heard from this band so far! (14.75/15)4. "Survival" (6:19) opening with some in-studio banter before Wendel (at least, I'm assuming it's Wendell) leading the band into a West African drum-and-chant opening (lasting 90 seconds!). I love this! And then at 1:45 the full band joins in, transitioning the music into some Memphis-ized High Life music--one that has some serious funk groovin' coming from Roy and Wendell as well as Robert's full organ chords and the tight horn section's accents and dominating lead melody blasts. In the middle of the fifth minute as Loughty Amao breaks free to solo with his tenor sax the rest of the band breaks into What's Going On-like party mingling noise in the background. Another awesome song! (9.5/10)5. "Move On" (4:34) opening with the "Oh-See-Bee-Sah" chant, the bass and percussion soon jump in with Wendel strumming acoustic guitar in a Django fashion to create a Caribbean-sounding High Life motif over which Wendel sings in a forceful Eric Burdon or Terry Kath-like singing voice and style, which changes the feel of the music into something more akin to War-like Jazz-Rock. Interesting. I like the sound palette, stylistic variety, but overall something's not quite working (besides the slightly murky overall mix). Maybe it's a bit over-filled: too busy; the Rock elements feel a little under-prepared and forced. (8.75/10)6. "Rabiatu" (5:07) a nice African-familiar High Life motif is taken into bluesier territory by all of the electrified instruments: Hammond organ, electric guitar, and watered-down bass line. The percussion line interlude in the third minute is cool--especially with Wendel's percussive rhythm guitar muted strumming and the deep, distant bass lines coming from both Ray's bass and Robert's Hammond. The horn work is very effective--very adeptly arranged. (8.875/10)7. "Woyaya" (4:27) PROCOL HARUM-like Hammond organ chords open this one before Wendel (barely) joins in to start the vocal choir up with his single-voiced recitation of the main lyric and melody, which is thereafter picked up by the whole band as a choir. They sound a bit like they're ending their night in an Irish pub with a drunken sing-a-long of some national (or local) anthem. Once they reach the fourth minute, as the choir join in singing the song title work over and over, things feel quite tight, but then they break into a percussion-only jam to finish it off for the final 45 seconds. Too bad! That "Woyaya" chant could've gone on a bit longer. A cool song--that could very easily be made into a whole-crowd anthem--that feels, to my mind, to be too loosely thrown together and condensed almost unnaturally when it could've been a nice eight or nine minute song. (8.875/10)Total Time: 40:44What a great leap forward for this band! Tony Visconti has figured the band out (proving his genius) and gotten superior sound, spirited performances of inspired compositions from this talented ensemble.A-/five stars; a minor masterpiece of mostly very-well-produced, very well composed African Jazz Rock. Very highly recommended.
items._cn_summary: OSIBISA 的第二张录音室专辑由 Tony Visconti 担任制作，Roger Dean 负责封面艺术。专辑融合了西非高生活节奏与孟菲斯布鲁斯摇滚，铜管与小号的搭配成为核心音色特征。制作水准较乐队前作有明显提升，乐器分离度和混音清晰度都有显著改善。器乐编排丰富，钢琴、风琴、吉他独奏与铜管组配合，融入桑塔纳式即兴段落和浸信会唱诗班人声段落。歌曲结构复杂多变，从部落鼓点到放克律动再到蓝调摇滚自由切换。整张专辑展现了非洲传统节奏与西方摇滚爵士乐融合的实验方向，跨文化元素丰富但制作手法相对传统，属于七十年代初世界融合浪潮中有一定代表性的作品。

items.body: Review by A Crimson Mellotron — Released in 2003 on Music for Nations, 'A Natural Disaster' is the seventh studio album fromAnathema, and the first one written almost entirely by guitarist Daniel Cavanagh. Undeniably adarker offering, this album has always been the odd one out - neither a continuation of the band'ssmoldering death-doom early style, not a clear indicator of what future releases would sound like.Combining drab alternative rock tropes with atmospheric passages and acoustic interludes, 'A NaturalDisaster' is more of an attempt to redefine the purpose of the band. Sprinkled all over this albumare a myriad of great ideas, that are unfortunately way too scattered in the final mix, which makesthe album somewhat of a forgettable and unimpressive listen. The sorrowful music played on manytracks appearing here reminds me of Katatonia and Porcupine Tree, and more remotely of Paradise Lostand Riverside, which renders this particular Anathema album slightly derivative.Interestingly enough, featured on this album is Vincent Cavanagh's twin brother Jamie, who plays thebass guitar for the first time on a major release with the band, following his early departure fromthe original lineup of Anathema, sometime around 1990-91. And so, as an album I have been fairlycritical of, I have to say that there are fine moments that make up for the weaker parts. Suchinstances of inspired and original music include opener 'Harmonium' with its desperate tones andclaustrophobic atmosphere, the peculiar piece 'Balance', on which Vincent Cavangh sings through avocoder, creating a feel of coldness and distance that is backed up by the moody keyboards. The song'Pulled Under at 2000 Metres a Second' has a post-punk appeal and is one of the surprising entrieson 'A Natural Disaster', while the hauntingly serene title track sees female vocalist Lee Douglasproviding excellent guest vocals. The final 10-minute-long instrumental 'Violence' could have beenmore appropriately constructed in order to fit the aesthetics of the album, at least in my humbleopinion, while the rest of the songs don't do much for me. This album probably suffers from a lackof direction and coherence, but I understand that people find within it a sincere expression ofgrief and melancholy, which I am able to appreciate.
items._cn_summary: Anathema第七张录音室专辑几乎由吉他手Daniel Cavanagh独自创作，呈现出比以往更暗沉的色彩。专辑融合了阴郁的另类摇滚语汇、氛围化段落与原声插曲，试图重新定义乐队的方向，但大量好想法散落在最终混音中，整体缺乏凝聚力和方向感。音乐情绪悲伤，与Katatonia、Porcupine Tree等乐队有相似之处，显得略显派生。亮点包括开篇曲压抑的紧迫感、《Balance》中使用声码器营造的冰冷疏离感、《Pulled Under at 2000 Metres a Second》的后朋克气质，以及同名曲中Lee Douglas的客座女声。尽管评论者整体评价偏批评，仍承认专辑中能感受到真挚的悲伤与忧郁表达。

items.body: Review by Matti — (Revisiting my brief reviews written in Finnish for Colossus prog magazine in 2013, pt. 2)On their 8th album the French group Nemo continues on the heavy prog path. The opening track of this 2-CD features intriguing a cappella vocals in the style of Gentle Giant, and there will come some more GG-reminding hooks later. The blues rocking guitar work, in addition to metallic connotations, brings to mind GG's Gary Green. Interesting rhythmic details are hidden amidst heavy riffs. Surely there are also modern prog metal elements too, in the highly strung guitar soli and in the synth sequences.But above all Nemo's compositions are mostly clever and alluring. Within the two discs there obviously are less worthy pieces too, so with some editings this would have been stronger as a single CD. Nevertheless Nemo is a refreshing acquaintance, even for an anti-metal listener like me.
items._genre: heavy prog / prog metal / eclectic progressive
items._cn_summary: 法国团体NEMO第八张专辑延续了重型前卫路线，双CD结构承载了较为饱满的音乐素材。开场曲目以Gentle Giant风格的无伴奏人声引入，复古对位法式的人声钩子贯穿全作。电吉他演奏兼具蓝调摇滚的根源性与金属化的尖锐感，密集的吉他独奏与合成器段落体现出现代前卫金属的特征。节奏细节在厚重 riff 的夹缝中若隐若现，显示编曲层面的巧思。整体作曲偏向精巧与诱惑力并重，但双碟中确实存在良莠不齐的段落，若精简为一碟则结构更紧实。对于反金属倾向的听众，NEMO提供了一个相对清新的入口。

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — As Albert e L'uomo Nero begins, a host of sensations from the 1970s comes to mind, Giallo films, the opening of The Exorcist, the movies of Dario Argento, for L'Ombra Della Sera utilized original instruments from that decade to recreate that atmosphere as faithfully as possible. Yet, of course, that was merely the starting point; the true significance lies in the composition and execution using those instruments. In this regard, they succeed brilliantly, as the final result is far more than a mere exercise in nostalgia or a commercial imitation.The Mellotron gives way to the Minimoog on "Gamma," and the classical composition stirs the emotions without veering into melodrama, evoking the spirit of 1970s Italian cinema, rich in music and steeped in the mystery of mansions harboring dark family secrets. Progressive elements expand to take on the forms of jazz-rock and psychedelia; one hears echoes of Genesis, Camel, and even Klaus Schulze, all flowing together with complete naturalness.Ritratto di Donna Velata showcases the richness of a beautiful and delicate composition they are capable of, with the unusual vibraphone and Mellotron duet. Fantastic Fly, in the time of a classic Bolero, highlights the double keyboard ensemble of Agostino Macor and Alessandro Corvaglia, followed by Fabio Zuffanti's bass. From emotive to mysterious and then epic...leaving no corner unexplored, both internally and externally."Come Andromeda" is even more experimental and delves deeper into free jazz; in contrast, "La Traccia Verde" features a funk groove strongly driven by the interplay between keyboards and flute, reminiscent of the Brazilian-influenced side of Billy Cobham or Les McCann. They fit squarely within the Italian tradition of moving effortlessly between genres and making each one their own, shifting from progressive rock to jazz, much like Banco del Mutuo Soccorso, Alphataurus, and so many others."La Ballata Di Carini" is sung by Alessandro Corvaglia, accompanied by a harpsichord that creates an almost theatrical, operatic atmosphere; the instrumental section, featuring keyboards, bass, and drums?then takes flight, engaging in a dialogue with the piano and incorporating recorded spoken passages to craft a tribute to 1970s Italian film and televisi�n, a powerful decade when the likes of Ugo Tognazzi, Marcello Mastroianni, and Vittorio Gassman could command the screen simply by standing in front of the camera.Le Venti Giornate di Torino is dedicated to the television adaptation of Giorgio De Maria's 1977 novel of the same name, recreating that atmosphere of gothic terror in a nineteen-minute suite. With excellent scales that seamlessly transition between sections, despite its variety of rhythms, it evokes the energy and mystery of King Crimson and Yes, the drama and tension of Genesis, and the classical composers?and that ominous sense of decadence of the Romantic era.As "Cento Campane" arrives, we can already picture the masks of the Venetian Carnival... all of Italy is present, North and South, lost and mingling within that magical anonymity; a magic as potent as the enveloping keyboards and percussion. Then, seamlessly, the final track begins: "A Blue Shadow," featuring the poetic saxophone of Martin Grice, an elegy so timeless it sounds modern, casting a shadow within the light, much like candles that seem as though they will never go out.
items._genre: progressive rock / jazz-rock / psychedelic / Italian retro prog
items._cn_summary: L'Ombra Della Sera以七十年代意大利电影配乐为美学原点，使用Mellotron、Minimoog、harpsichord、vibraphone等当时乐器重构氛围。专辑跨越多重风格边界：古典化的情感叙事融合爵士摇滚与迷幻色彩，曲目中插入自由爵士实验段落及放克拉格段落，展现意大利乐队在流派间自由切换的传统。器乐编制以双键盘为主轴，搭配贝斯、鼓与长笛，部分长篇组曲借鉴King Crimson的节奏张力与Genesis的戏剧结构，十九分钟的电视改编配乐段落将哥特恐怖气氛铺陈至顶点。整体以电影化叙事和复古音色为核心，情感跨度从细腻到史诗，虽具融合意识，但本质仍属复古情怀驱动的前卫摇滚范畴。

items.body: Post-punk band False Flowers released an official visualizer for their cover of Adam and the Ants’ “Beat My Guest”. The song is the B-side to “Secret Futures”, a two-song single out now on Strange Club Records, with UK distribution through No Front Teeth Records. Guitarist Brian Hanover, who wrote lead track “Secret Futures”, described how the cover came together: “When we first started playing together in 2024 I mentioned wanting to cover this. The idea fell by the wayside until early Jan 2026, when I mentioned it again and by this point knew we could make this sound like us by adding atmosphere, moodiness, and a different energy; it needed to be done right to honor such a great song. By Feb 2026 we had recorded it for the B side of Secret Futures.” ‘Beat My Guest’ backs the ‘Secret Futures’ single “Secret Futures” b/w “Beat My Guest” is the follow-up to False Flowers’ self-titled debut mini-LP. Both songs were recorded by Patrick Hills at Earthtone, the studio behind releases by 7 Seconds, Tera Melos and King Woman. Lead track “Secret Futures” pairs an upbeat, punk-rooted composition with lyrics about time spent on insignificant distractions rather than meaningful moments in life. The single has been available since July 3 through Strange Club Records, with digital release also through Amazon and iTunes and streaming on Apple Music, Deezer and Tidal, among other platforms. A self-produced music video for “Secret Futures” launched July 10 on the band’s YouTube channel. The physical 7-inch vinyl is available to order through Strange Club Records. False Flowers is already working on a new album, planned for 2027. The band continues to play alongside acts including Home Front, Primitive Heads, MESS, Generacion Suicida, Alter Girl and Guilty Strangers, with two confirmed Sacramento, California shows: August 3, 2026 – Cafe Colonial, with Bleakness and Rose Lyon September 3, 2026 – Cafe Colonial, with Bloodstains, Máscaras and Riot Radio About False Flowers False Flowers is Lory Gil (also of Rad and Sick Burn) on keyboard and vocals, Brian Hanover (also of Hanover Saints, Whiskey Rebels and Union Hearts) on guitar and backing vocals, Conrad Melancon (also of Cold Trap and Mob Rule) on bass, and Craig Hancock (also of Rad and Sick Burn) on drums. The band’s dark, atmospheric post-punk draws comparisons to Siouxsie and the Banshees, Bauhaus, TSOL, The Damned and Christian Death. False Flowers debuted with a self-titled mini-LP before releasing the “Secret Futures” b/w “Beat My Guest” single on Strange Club Records, now backed by an official visualizer for the cover track.
items._cn_summary: 这是一篇关于后朋克乐队False Flowers发布单曲及翻唱MV的新闻稿。乐队翻唱了Adam and the Ants的经典曲目《Beat My Guest》，作为单曲《Secret Futures》的B面发行。吉他手Brian Hanover介绍了翻唱动机，强调要为这首经典注入氛围感、阴郁气质和不同的能量。录音由Earthtone工作室完成，制作过7 Seconds、Tera Melos和King Woman等乐队作品。乐队的暗黑氛围后朋克风格被拿来与Siouxsie and the Banshees、Bauhaus、TSOL、The Damned和Christian Death相比较，键盘手与吉他主导的编制体现出典型的暗潮后朋克特征。整体定位属于地下独立小厂牌Strange Club Records发行，与用户暗潮口味有一定契合度，但缺乏实验性元素和跨界融合，新闻稿性质较强。

items.body: Johannesburg gothic rock band The Awakening, led by Ashton Nyte, released the single and video “Until The Dawn” on 23 July 2026, the first material from the band’s upcoming 13th album, “The Lost Theatre”. The album is out 23 August 2026 through Intervention Arts. Nyte describes “Until The Dawn” as the track that started the new album: “[It] is the song that gave birth to The Lost Theatre. I’m always writing songs, but this one told me a new album was on the way, and it had to be the first single. It is essentially a song about the courage of asking for help. It is a song of hope.” The single is streaming on Spotify. ‘Until The Dawn’ opens The Awakening’s ‘The Lost Theatre’ “The Lost Theatre” is the follow-up to The Awakening’s 2024 self-titled album, which reached number 3 on Germany’s Deutsche Alternative Charts. All music and lyrics on the new album are written, composed and performed by Ashton Nyte, produced by Nyte at Intervention Studios in the US and published by Intervention Arts / ASCAP. The album and a selection of limited-edition items are available for pre-order through The Awakening’s stores in Germany, the UK and the US. The Lost Theatre Tour dates 2026 The Awakening will support the album with a run of German shows, following last year’s worldwide Haunting Tour, which included headline dates in Germany, Poland, France, the Netherlands, the US, Canada, the UK, Mexico and South Africa. Tickets are available through the band’s site. 2 September 2026 – Dortmund, Germany – Pauluskirche (solo) 3 September 2026 – Köln, Germany – Club Volta 4 September 2026 – Hamburg, Germany – Nochtspeicher 5 September 2026 – NCN Festival 6 September 2026 – Berlin, Germany – Maschinenhaus About The Awakening The Awakening is a gothic rock and darkwave band from Johannesburg, South Africa, built around singer, multi-instrumentalist and producer Ashton Nyte, who writes, records and produces the project’s material and also releases solo work and collaborations, among them recurring appearances with Beauty In Chaos. The band’s back catalogue includes the double album “The Passage Remains” (2022) and earlier releases such as “The Carriage” (2015), and it has toured Europe alongside Wayne Hussey of The Mission. The Awakening issued its self-titled album in 2024, previewed by the single “Mirror Midnight”, and returned in 2025 with the “Through The Veil” video and a European tour announcement. “Until The Dawn” now opens the band’s 13th album, “The Lost Theatre”, due 23 August 2026 and backed by a run of German tour dates in September.
items._cn_summary: 南非约翰内斯堡哥特摇滚乐队The Awakening由Ashton Nyte主导，发布单曲《Until The Dawn》及第十三张专辑《The Lost Theatre》。专辑由Nyte独立创作、编曲并制作，所有音乐与歌词均在美国的Intervention Studios完成，预计于2026年8月发行。Nyte将这首单曲视为整张专辑的起点，主题围绕求助的勇气与希望。乐队上一张同名专辑曾在德国Deutsche Alternative Charts攀升至第三位，本张专辑将以一批德国巡演作为推广，其中包含多场独奏与音乐节演出。Nyte在体制内保持高度独立，与Beauty In Chaos有过合作，巡演经历涉及欧、美、非洲多个国家。在声音的实验性方面，文章没有提供具体的技法或结构描述，难以判断其在前沿层面的突破，整体定位仍处于传统哥特摇滚的框架之内。

items.body: California-based experimental extreme metal duo Antania has joined the roster of Italian label Argonauta Records, the band and label confirmed. The move follows Antania’s earlier deal with Triad Records, which released the duo’s second album, “The God Complex,” in January 2024. The band builds its sound without guitars or bass, using synthesizers, distortion and electronic manipulation instead. The duo, made up of Dr. Luna and Kali Mortem, mixes industrial black metal with experimental electronics, combining mechanical rhythm programming, low-end bass tones and dense atmospheric production. The band cites Dodheimsgard, Mysticum and Thorns among its extreme-metal influences, alongside the industrial electronics of Skinny Puppy and Ministry. Grand Sounds PR, the agency handling the announcement, describes Antania’s music as “an oppressive fusion of mechanical precision, crushing low-end frequencies and bleak, immersive atmospheres.” Lyrically, Antania draws on true crime, psychological horror and real-world violence, a focus already present on “Lividity” and continued through “The God Complex.” Antania joins Argonauta Records roster No debut release through Argonauta Records has been announced yet; the label and band have said only that more details will follow in the coming weeks. Argonauta Records, founded in Genoa, Italy in 2012 by Gero Lucisano, has built a roster centered on doom, sludge, stoner and extreme metal acts, including Los Natas, Mitochondrial Sun, Ancient VVisdom and Snail. About Antania Antania is a two-piece project from Joshua Tree, California, formed by Dr. Luna and vocalist Kali Mortem, who is a U.S. Army veteran and was featured in Jeremy Saffer’s book “Daughters of Darkness.” The duo released its debut album, Lividity, in June 2023, a bass-heavy record with songs drawn from true-crime accounts of murder and violence. Antania then signed with Triad Records in December 2023, and the label released the duo’s follow-up album, “The God Complex,” on January 5, 2024. In 2024, the band toured Europe alongside Psyclon Nine and Devil M. The band now moves to Argonauta Records for its next chapter, with a debut release for the label expected to be detailed in the coming weeks.
items._genre: industrial black metal / experimental electronics / darkwave
items._cn_summary: 文章报道了加州实验极端金属二人组Antania签约意大利厂牌Argonauta Records的消息。该乐队由Dr. Luna与Kali Mortem组成，完全摒弃吉他与贝斯，以合成器、失真效果与电子操控构建声音，将工业黑金属与实验电子乐相融合，依赖机械节奏编程、低频贝斯音色与厚重氛围制作。乐队自称受到Dodheimsgard、Mysticum、Thorns等极端金属乐队以及Skinny Puppy、Ministry工业电子的影响。歌词取材于真实犯罪、心理学恐怖与现实暴力，此主题贯穿首张专辑《Lividity》与第二张专辑《The God Complex》。2024年乐队曾与Psyclon Nine、Devil M同台巡演欧洲。新厂牌旗下首张作品尚未公布详情。文章内容实为厂牌签约新闻稿，缺乏具体音乐评论与深度分析。

items.body: Vancouver, Canada post-punk band ACTORS released the single “Youth” on 17 July 2026 via Artoffact Records. The digital single follows this year’s earlier singles “Left On Read”, released 24 April 2026, and “CTRL”. It arrives while the band works on a new album, the follow-up to 2022’s “Reanimated”. “Youth” pairs a driving bassline with sharp synths and guitar, built around motorik-style percussion. Radio outlet Kool Rock Radio named “Youth” its Single of the Week on 20 July 2026. Video for ‘Youth’ ACTORS released an official music video for “Youth” alongside the single. Tour dates for ACTORS “Youth” arrives ahead of the “Our Love Will Live Forever” tour, which runs through Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, France, the UK and Canada from September through October 2026. About ACTORS ACTORS formed in Vancouver, British Columbia, in 2012, founded by vocalist and guitarist Jason Corbett, who also runs the Vancouver recording studio Jacknife Sound. The band’s current lineup adds Shannon Hemmett on synth and vocals, Kendall Wooding on bass and vocals, and Adam Fink on drums. The band released its debut album “It Will Come to You” in 2018. Artoffact Records signed ACTORS, and the band went on to release its second album, “Acts of Worship”, in October 2021. In 2022, ACTORS issued the digipak EP “Reanimated”, a self-released collection of seven remastered b-sides and demo tracks including “How Deep Is The Hole”. ACTORS has continued releasing singles through Artoffact Records, including “In Real Life”, later remixed by Dave Clarke, and “Love U More”. Band member Shannon Hemmett also records as Leathers, releasing the debut album “Ultraviolet” in 2024. “Youth” is the band’s third 2026 single, released as ACTORS continues work on the follow-up to “Reanimated” and prepares for the “Our Love Will Live Forever” tour.
